ngaap.guidance: 2023 guidance INCREASED (26-Jul-2023; excludes Aerojet Rocketdyne): Revenue $18.0B - $18.3B, up ~5.5% - 7.0% (prior $17.4B - $17.8B, up ~2% - 4%); segment operating income $2.7B - $2.8B (unchanged; now toward the midpoint); segment operating margin ~15% (prior 15.2% - 15.7%); non-GAAP EPS $12.15 - $12.55 (prior $12.00 - $12.50); adjusted free cash flow $2.0B+ (unchanged). By segment: SAS revenue $6.7B - $6.8B (prior $6.4B - $6.5B), operating income $735M - $760M (prior $700M - $750M); IMS $6.7B - $6.8B (prior $6.5B - $6.7B), $765M - $800M (prior $800M - $850M); CS $4.9B - $5.0B (prior $4.8B - $4.9B), $1.20B - $1.23B (prior $1.15B - $1.20B). Other: FAS/CAS pension adjustment, net ~$395M (prior ~$375M; service cost ~(25), CAS pension cost ~(120) vs ~(100), FAS/CAS operating adjustment ~95 vs ~75, non-service FAS pension income ~300); net interest expense ~$420M (prior ~$400M); acquisition-related transaction and integration expenses ~$100M; non-GAAP effective tax rate 13.0% - 13.5% (prior 13% - 14%); average diluted shares ~191M; capex ~$275M.
ngaap.notes: 2023 basis: 'Segment operating income' in the tables is GAAP segment operating income; 'Non-GAAP segment operating income' excludes segment-level impairment charges. Non-GAAP EPS = EPS (no discontinued operations in 2023) plus the after-tax adjustments listed: amortization of acquisition-related intangibles; additional cost of sales related to the fair value step-up in inventory sold (TDL, new 1Q23); L3Harris merger-related integration expenses (2022 only); acquisition-related transaction and integration expenses (TDL, AJRD); pre-acquisition and other divestiture-related expenses; business divestiture-related gains; impairment of other assets; and the enterprise transformation program, renamed LHX NeXt in 2Q23 (new 1Q23). Pension (FAS/CAS operating adjustment, non-service FAS pension income) is NOT excluded. Adjusted free cash flow = operating cash flow less capex (net of proceeds) plus cash used for merger / acquisition-related transaction and integration costs. The FCF bridge in the release is the quarter column; cf in this file is year to date. 2Q23: 'Enterprise transformation program' renamed 'LHX NeXt' ($22M: $12M third-party consulting, $10M workforce optimization, incremental IT and other). Non-GAAP income 567 = net income 351 + total adjustments after taxes 177 (amortization 173, inventory step-up 15, acquisition-related 36, pre-acquisition/divestiture-related 2, VIS divestiture gain (26), unallocated impairment of other assets 21, LHX NeXt 22, taxes (66)) + total segment adjustments 39 (impairment of other assets: IMS 12, SAS 27), which the table shows in the segment section and not in the 'sum of A' total. Impairment of other assets $60M total = $21M in-process R&D, $9M facility closures, $30M restructuring of a customer contract. The table misprints the prior-year per-share adjustment and non-GAAP EPS as 3.96 and 6.38 (correct: 0.81 and $3.23, as shown on the letter's EPS chart and in the Q2-22 release). Net debt / adjusted EBITDA 2.5x. No adjusted EBIT published (GAAP EBIT 483, 10.3%).
